title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and green for the sodium and potassium traces; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Gating variables distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a refractory-period plot to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 measures the refractory period with `second_pulse_threshold` but never plots it.

## Context
The needed amplitude for a second spike falls steeply with the gap between pulses; a plot makes the idea concrete.

## Expected outcome
A figure of second-pulse threshold against the gap, saved to `out/` and described in the notes.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Labelled axes with units
- [ ] A caption in the session notes

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 4: spike-frequency adaptation
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's adaptation milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Real neurons slow down under a constant input; the shipped LIF neuron does not.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: ramped stimulus with a live f-I curve
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows the voltage, the gates and an f-I curve building up under a ramp; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A stable integrator that works at dt = 0.5 ms
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
